narr: Scattered showers and thunderstorms resulted in flash flooding over northwestern Connecticut Saturday-Sunday July 17-18, 2021.
ev: Law enforcement reported flooding of streets along the Housatonic River in New Milford.
Law enforcement reported numerous streets flooded in Watertown. Some creeks and streams have also overflowed their banks.
A house reportedly was inundated with water up to the first floor.
There was a report of an entire road being impassable near Route 41 and Lambert Road.
